name: CAFE LA SUNSET
source:
Main character ran a restaurant for five years before it went bankrupt. One day he's invited by his uncle to be a manager of "Sunset" cafe that is about to be closed in a month's time. What encounters await him during the time left?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公经营一家餐厅五年，最终宣告破产。某天，叔叔邀请他担任“Sunset”咖啡馆的经理，而这家店将在一个月后关闭。所剩时间里，会有怎样的邂逅等待着他？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
